set.text:
Dear Ms. Carter,

I'm Jaehyun from apartment 304, right above you. I wanted to apologize in person, but I missed you in the hallway twice, so I am leaving this note. On Saturday night I had some friends over to study, and I realize we were far louder than we should have been, especially after ten o'clock. I can only imagine how tiring that must have been after a long day. I assure you it will not happen again; from now on, we will move to the library after nine. If anything else ever disturbs you, please feel free to knock on my door or leave a message. I would much rather hear about a problem early than have it grow into something bigger. I have left a small box of tea at your door as a token of my regret.

Best wishes,
Jaehyun

patches.why: Original sentence 'wanted to write this note to apologize in person' is self-contradictory; the Q2 key still holds.

set.text:
Host: Good evening, Olive Tree Kitchen. How may I help you?
Customer: Hi, I'd like to reserve a table for six on Saturday evening, if you have one.
Host: Let me check. What time were you thinking?
Customer: Around seven would be ideal. It's for my father's retirement dinner.
Host: Congratulations to him! Unfortunately, seven is fully booked, but I can offer a table at six thirty or one at eight fifteen.
Customer: Hmm, my grandmother goes to bed early, so six thirty would be better. Is there a quiet corner?
Host: Yes, there's a round table near the window, away from the kitchen. May I have your name and number?
Customer: It's Kim, and my number is 555-0142.
Host: Thank you, Ms. Kim. One more thing: if you'd like a cake, you're welcome to bring one, and we will not charge a serving fee.
Customer: That's very thoughtful. Thank you so much.

To meet a friend after work
To thank the restaurant staff
To celebrate her father's retirement
qs.why: 아버지의 은퇴 기념 저녁 식사 때문이에요.

qs.why: 할머니가 일찍 주무시기 때문이에요.
